info.title: PDF Blocks
info.description: PDF Blocks is a secure, reliable, and fast service to work with PDF documents in your flow. Actions include: Merge PDF documents, add or remove passwords, watermark documents, remove, extract, reverse, and rotate pages, and more. Check https://www.pdfblocks.com/power-automate for documentation, examples, and tutorials. Users can choose to process their PDF documents in US or European servers to comply with data location requirements.

parameters.description: The content of the PDF document

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password required to open the file

parameters.name: encryption_algorithm
parameters.description: The algorithm used to encrypt the PDF document

parameters.name: file

parameters.name: owner_password

post.summary: Add a text watermark to a PDF
post.description: Add a text watermark to a PDF document. Choose from many watermark templates in https://www.pdfblocks.com/docs/power-automate/add-text-watermark-to-pdf

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The content of the PDF document

parameters.name: line_1
parameters.description: The first line of text of the watermark

parameters.name: line_2
parameters.description: The second line of text of the watermark

parameters.name: line_3
parameters.description: The third line of text of the watermark

parameters.name: template
parameters.description: The id of the watermark template. To see all available templates visit https://www.pdfblocks.com/docs/power-automate/add-text-watermark-to-pdf

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: The color of the text of the watermark

parameters.name: transparency
parameters.description: Transparency level for the watermark from 0 (opaque) to 100 (transparent)

parameters.name: margin
parameters.description: Distance in inches from the border of the page to the watermark

parameters.name: pages
parameters.description: The pages to stamp, as a comma-separated list of page numbers and ranges (for example 1..3,5). A negative number counts from the end (-1 is the last page). Leave empty to stamp every page.

schema.description: The content of the watermarked PDF document

parameters.name: transparency

parameters.name: margin

parameters.name: pages
parameters.description: The pages to stamp, as a comma-separated list of page numbers and ranges (for example 1..3,5). A negative number counts from the end (-1 is the last page). Leave empty to stamp every page.

post.description: Extract one or more pages from a PDF document. https://www.pdfblocks.com/docs/power-automate/extract-pages-from-pdf

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The content of the PDF document

parameters.name: pages
parameters.description: The pages to extract, as a comma-separated list of page numbers and ranges (for example 1..3,5). A negative number counts from the end (-1 is the last page). Leave empty to extract all pages. Do not combine with First Page / Last Page.

parameters.name: first_page
parameters.description: First page of the extracted PDF document. Legacy field kept for backward compatibility; prefer Pages. Do not combine with Pages.

parameters.name: last_page
parameters.description: Last page of the extracted PDF document. Legacy field kept for backward compatibility; prefer Pages. Do not combine with Pages.

schema.description: The content of the extracted PDF document

post.summary: Merge PDF documents from an array
post.description: Combine an array of PDF documents into a single PDF document. Use this when the documents come from a loop or an earlier action instead of fixed file fields. https://www.pdfblocks.com/docs/power-automate/merge-pdf-documents

documents.description: The PDF documents to merge. The merged document keeps this order.

fileContent.description: The content of the PDF document.

fileName.description: An optional name for the PDF document. The documents are merged in array order, so the name is only for readability.

schema.description: The content of the merged PDF document

post.description: Remove one or more pages from a PDF document. https://www.pdfblocks.com/docs/power-automate/remove-pages-from-pdf

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The content of the PDF document

parameters.name: pages
parameters.description: The pages to remove, as a comma-separated list of page numbers and ranges (for example 2,4..6). A negative number counts from the end (-1 is the last page). At least one page must remain. Do not combine with First Page / Last Page.

parameters.name: first_page
parameters.description: First page to remove in the PDF document. Legacy field kept for backward compatibility; prefer Pages. Do not combine with Pages.

parameters.name: last_page
parameters.description: Last page to remove in the PDF document. Legacy field kept for backward compatibility; prefer Pages. Do not combine with Pages.

schema.description: The content of the PDF document with some pages removed

post.summary: Reorder the pages of a PDF
post.description: Rearrange the pages of a PDF document into a new order. Pages left out are dropped and a page listed more than once is repeated, so this doubles as extract-and-reorder. https://www.pdfblocks.com/docs/power-automate/reorder-pages-of-pdf

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The content of the PDF document

parameters.name: page_order
parameters.description: The desired page order, as a comma-separated list of page numbers and ranges (for example 3,1,2). A range may run backwards, so 10..5 walks from page 10 down to page 5. Pages left out are dropped; a page listed more than once is repeated.

schema.description: The content of the reordered PDF document

post.summary: Reverse the pages of a PDF
post.description: Reverse the order of the pages of a PDF document. https://www.pdfblocks.com/docs/power-automate/reverse-pages-of-pdf

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The content of the PDF document

schema.description: The content of the PDF document with the pages reversed

post.description: Rotate one or more pages in a PDF document. https://www.pdfblocks.com/docs/power-automate/rotate-pages-in-pdf

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The content of the PDF document

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The angle of rotation of the page

parameters.name: pages
parameters.description: The pages to rotate, as a comma-separated list of page numbers and ranges (for example 1..3,5). A negative number counts from the end (-1 is the last page). Leave empty to rotate all pages. Do not combine with First Page / Last Page.

parameters.name: first_page
parameters.description: First page to rotate in the PDF document. Legacy field kept for backward compatibility; prefer Pages. Do not combine with Pages.

parameters.name: last_page
parameters.description: Last page to rotate in the PDF document. Legacy field kept for backward compatibility; prefer Pages. Do not combine with Pages.

schema.description: The content of the PDF document with some pages rotated

post.summary: Split a PDF at a page
post.description: Split a PDF document into two documents at a page boundary. The pages before the split page form the first part; the split page and everything after form the second. Returns the output PDF documents as a list of files. https://www.pdfblocks.com/docs/power-automate/split-pdf-at-page

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The content of the PDF document

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number that begins the second part. Must be between 2 and the number of pages in the document so both parts contain pages.

documents.description: The output PDF documents, in order.

name.description: The name of the PDF document (00001.pdf, 00002.pdf, and so on).

content.description: The content of the PDF document.

content_type.description: The media type of the document.

post.summary: Split a PDF into page groups
post.description: Split a PDF document into page groups that you define, where each group becomes one output PDF. Returns the output PDF documents as a list of files. https://www.pdfblocks.com/docs/power-automate/split-pdf-into-page-groups

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The content of the PDF document

parameters.name: groups
parameters.description: The groups to split into, separated by ; (semicolon). Within a group, pages and ranges are separated by , (comma). Each group becomes one output PDF, in written order. For example, 2..8,29;1 produces two PDFs: the first with pages 2 through 8 then 29, the second with page 1.

documents.description: The output PDF documents, in order.

name.description: The name of the PDF document (00001.pdf, 00002.pdf, and so on).

content.description: The content of the PDF document.

content_type.description: The media type of the document.

post.summary: Split a PDF by page count
post.description: Split a PDF document into consecutive parts of a fixed number of pages. The last part holds the remaining pages and may be smaller. Returns the output PDF documents as a list of files. https://www.pdfblocks.com/docs/power-automate/split-pdf-by-page-count

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The content of the PDF document

parameters.name: page_count
parameters.description: The number of pages in each output PDF document. The last part holds the remaining pages and may be smaller.

documents.description: The output PDF documents, in order.

name.description: The name of the PDF document (00001.pdf, 00002.pdf, and so on).

content.description: The content of the PDF document.

content_type.description: The media type of the document.

post.summary: Split a PDF by file size
post.description: Split a PDF document into multiple smaller PDF documents, each no larger than a maximum file size. Returns the output PDF documents as a list of files. https://www.pdfblocks.com/docs/power-automate/split-pdf-by-file-size

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The content of the PDF document

parameters.name: maximum_bytes
parameters.description: The maximum size in bytes of each output PDF document (for example 1048576 for 1 MB). A single page larger than this size is returned as its own part that exceeds the limit.

documents.description: The output PDF documents, in order.

name.description: The name of the PDF document (00001.pdf, 00002.pdf, and so on).

content.description: The content of the PDF document.

content_type.description: The media type of the document.
